readings.title: The bowl returned full
readings.instruction: Read the original passage and choose the best answer to each question.
readings.content: A staff canteen weighed leftovers for a week and found that rice made up much of the waste. Rather than reduce every portion equally, it offered two bowl sizes and allowed second servings. The kitchen recorded both leftovers and extra servings during a second week. Waste fell, while people who wanted more could still obtain it. The manager kept asking for comments because a quieter complaint was not necessarily a satisfied customer.
knowledgePoints: 阅读理解：主旨、细节、推断与词义

readings.title: The label behind the jar
readings.instruction: Read the original passage and choose the best answer to each question.
readings.content: Volunteers reorganised a community pantry by moving older stock to the front. Yet several jars still went unused. Their date labels faced the wall, so helpers could not easily decide which to choose. Turning labels outward solved part of the problem. A simple stock card recorded arrivals and removals. The group learned that a sensible rule needed a physical arrangement that made the rule easy to follow during a busy cooking session.
knowledgePoints: 阅读理解：主旨、细节、推断与词义

readings.title: Orders before the market
readings.instruction: Read the original passage and choose the best answer to each question.
readings.content: A small community cafe bought vegetables every morning according to last month's average sales. On days with large group visits, it often ran short; on quiet days, food remained. It began asking groups to book simple lunch choices the day before. Walk-in visitors were still welcome, so the cook kept a flexible portion of the menu. Advance information improved purchasing, but the cafe avoided treating a forecast as an exact promise about demand.
knowledgePoints: 阅读理解：主旨、细节、推断与词义

readings.title: The recipe with a question mark
readings.instruction: Read the original passage and choose the best answer to each question.
readings.content: A community cookbook collected recipes from local residents. One writer submitted 'a little oil' and 'cook until ready'. Experienced cooks understood, but beginners requested clearer guidance. Editors asked contributors to add approximate amounts and describe visible changes, such as softened onions. Each contributor approved the revision before publication. The cookbook preserved personal voices while making instructions more usable; clarity did not require every recipe to sound as though one person had written it.
knowledgePoints: 阅读理解：主旨、细节、推断与词义

translation.stem:
Translate this original passage into natural Chinese, preserving its meaning and logical connections.

Reducing food waste requires attention to what people actually eat. A smaller first serving may be useful when additional food remains available. Records can show patterns, but conversations explain why those patterns occur. A kitchen learns most when it combines careful observation with respect for the different needs of the people it serves.
translation.referenceAnswer: 减少食物浪费需要关注人们实际上吃了多少。在仍可添餐的情况下，第一份少盛一些可能是有用的。记录可以显示规律，而交流则解释这些规律为何出现。厨房把细心观察与尊重就餐者的不同需求结合起来时，能够获得最多的认识。
translation.explanation: 参考译文不是唯一答案；信息完整、逻辑准确且中文自然的其他译法同样有效。

writing.stem:
Write about 120 words in English for this original simulation task.

Write a notice inviting neighbours to contribute recipes to a community cookbook. Explain what information each recipe should include, how editors will handle changes, and the submission deadline.
writing.sampleAnswer: Our neighbourhood is preparing a community cookbook, and we welcome a recipe that matters to you. Please include the ingredients, approximate quantities, number of servings and the main cooking steps. Describing a visible sign, such as a vegetable becoming soft, will help less experienced cooks. You may also add a short memory explaining why you chose the dish. Send your contribution to the community desk by 30 October. Editors may suggest clearer wording, but we will ask for your approval before changing the recipe. We hope the collection will reflect different households rather than one style of cooking. A simple everyday meal is just as welcome as a dish for a special occasion.
writing.explanation: 范文展示一种可行的回应；允许不同观点和例子，按任务完成、组织和语言评分。
